speaker: Doctor
text: Since the Hepatitis A test is negative, we need to investigate other causes of acute hepatitis. Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, and did you consume any raw or undercooked shellfish during your trip to the state fair? REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_B_Surface_Antigen

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Hepatitis B surface antigen indicates an active Hepatitis B infection, which explains your elevated liver enzymes and symptoms. To determine if this is an acute or chronic infection, I need to check for IgM antibodies. REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_B_IgM

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative IgM suggests this is likely a chronic Hepatitis B infection rather than an acute one. I will request a test for Hepatitis B e-antigen to assess viral replication activity and liver imaging to check for any structural changes. REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_B_e_Antigen, Liver_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal HBV DNA result despite a positive e-antigen is unusual and suggests a potential false positive or a rare variant, so I need to clarify if you have any history of liver disease or prior hepatitis treatment.
